A single-action thrown Strike; the 'off-guard the first time' rider is target-side and GM-tracked.

Extends the range of the Taunt action to 120 feet; an action's range is not a modelled statistic.
Extends tongue-delivered touch spells and simple Interacts 5 feet beyond your reach; reach for non-Strike uses is not a modelled statistic and there is no reach field.

An always-on detect magic effect plus an enhanced Seek; it is a detection ability adjudicated at the table with no numeric statistic, and it is not one of the modelled senses (darkvision, low-light, scent, tremorsense, see-invisibility, lifesense). Identical text to Magic Sense: an always-on detect magic detection ability with no statistic and no matching sense entry.

The feat gives the player a real PICK — formulas for four common magic items of 2nd level or lower — and nothing records it. effectChoices can only enumerate explicit options or filter spells (there is no item filter), and the only formula-pick lane that exists is the bespoke snare one (SNARE_FORMULA_KEY in src/rules/snareFormulas.ts, stored in build.extraChoices). A magic-item formula-book pick lane is missing.
